source.observed_statement: Agreement announced for 900 MW across multiple data center projects; initial shipments planned for 2027. Neither commissioned capacity nor realised cash flow.

assumptions.cost_basis: Hypothetical temporary power service. Margin is IT contribution after non-energy variable costs, before electricity; power price includes fuel, conversion losses and variable O&M. Fixed fee covers standby service. Upfront cost includes mobilization, connection, demobilization and all incremental fixed costs. Common facility capex and post-grid operation cancel. No residual value, tax, financing, carbon price, outage penalty, minimum take or stranded contract liability modelled. Permits, gas capacity, customer readiness and SLA feasibility require diligence.
